mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1500, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields in equities.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 2% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 in a month, the strong labor market boosts economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and GDP growth
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month, indicating strong supply-side growth, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when INDPRO growth > 1% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annualized growth rate (GDPC1) below 2% signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
evidence_refs: fact:historical GDP growth and stock market performance
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth < 2%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) growth exceeds 3% annually, the tightening monetary policy and high inflation lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on signal: the labor market's influence on the economy is constant, thus the sign of the difference between payroll employment (PAYEMS) and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) multiplied by 100 predicts the direction of S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and stock market performance
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or the signal's direction is incorrect in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional signal: in a post-shock recovery regime, a rise in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% in a month leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors anticipate strong economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when RSAFS growth > 5% in post-shock recovery regimes, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
